title: Every morning they would both have brekky, simple but perfectly served,
html_source: “Brekky” is of course breakfast, nicknamed with painful cuteness in Edy’s fantasies of marriage.

anchor.text: every morning they would both have brekky, simple but perfectly served,
anchor.prefix: ed sweeping moustache and they would go on the continent for their honeymoon (three wonderful weeks!) and then, when they settled down in a nice snug and cosy little homely house,
anchor.suffix:
for their own two selves and before he went out to business he would give his dear little wifey a good hearty hug and gaze for a moment deep down into her eyes.
